mapper.update: UPDATE dm_change_transfer SET transfer_status = 'PROCESSING', gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{transferId} AND transfer_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE dm_change_transfer SET transfer_status = 'PENDING', schedule_time = NOW(), last_error = 'Recovered stale processing transfer', gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE transfer_status = 'PROCESSING' AND gmt_modified < #{staleBefore}

UPDATE dm_change_transfer SET transfer_status = 'SUCCESS', ref_target_change_id = #{targetChangeId}, last_error = NULL, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{transferId} AND transfer_status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE dm_change_transfer SET transfer_status = 'PENDING', schedule_time = #{scheduleTime}, try_times = try_times + 1, last_error = #{errorMessage}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{transferId} AND transfer_status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE dm_change_transfer SET transfer_status = 'FAILED', try_times = try_times + 1, last_error = #{errorMessage}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{transferId} AND transfer_status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE dm_change_transfer SET transfer_status = 'PENDING', schedule_time = NOW(), try_times = 0, last_error = NULL, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE owner_uid = #{ownerUid} AND id = #{transferId} AND transfer_status = 'FAILED'
